# BrandSetu Digital

> BrandSetu Digital is a digital marketing agency based in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India. We help businesses grow online through SEO, branding, social media marketing, web design and development, performance advertising, and content production.

## Pages
- [Home](https://brandsetudigital.com/): Overview of services, brands, and the BrandSetu approach to digital growth.
- [Services](https://brandsetudigital.com/services): SEO, branding, social media marketing, web design & development, performance ads, and shoot/editing.
- [Our Work](https://brandsetudigital.com/work): Portfolio of brands we've helped grow, plus team members and case studies.
- [About / Our Story](https://brandsetudigital.com/about): Mission, vision, leadership, and the values driving our work.
- [Careers](https://brandsetudigital.com/career): Open roles in design, engineering, marketing, and DevOps.
- [Contact](https://brandsetudigital.com/contact): Email, phone, location, and an enquiry form.

## Services
- SEO and organic growth
- Branding and brand strategy
- Social media marketing
- Web design and development
- Performance marketing and paid ads
- Content production, shoots, and editing
- AI automation and maintenance
